==Description==
'''Egg Launcher''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] premium track. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote and it can be interacted with.

When using the emote, the player will be armed with an egg launcher. The player can press the left mouse button to launch eggs with it. The emote makes a sound when launching eggs and when the fired eggs land on the surface.

This emote was obtainable at Level 37 of the Spring Frenzy Battle Pass premium track, which cost {{Bunz|1,320}} or {{Robux|169}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|22,860}} or {{Robux|3,861}}.
